description:
Log in to Moodle as admin (username: admin, password: Admin1234!) at http://localhost/moodle.

Navigate to the course "Introduction to Biology" (BIO101). Post a welcome announcement in the course's built-in Announcements forum:

1. Find and open the "Announcements" forum (it is a default forum in every Moodle course).
2. Click "Add discussion topic" (or "Add a new topic").
3. Enter the following:
   - Subject: "Welcome to Introduction to Biology - Spring 2026"
   - Message: "Dear students, Welcome to BIO101 Introduction to Biology. This semester we will cover fundamental concepts including cell biology, genetics, and ecology. Please review the course syllabus and complete the introductory survey by the end of the first week. Office hours are Tuesdays and Thursdays from 2:00 PM to 4:00 PM in Room 301. Looking forward to a great semester! Best regards, Dr. Smith"
4. Post the discussion.

The announcement should appear as a new discussion topic in the Announcements forum.
